delivery_phases.title: DB schema
delivery_phases.qa_verify_command: cd linkshelf && sqlite3 linkshelf.db '.tables' | grep -q links && sqlite3 linkshelf.db '.schema links' | grep -q 'CREATE TABLE links'

delivery_phases.title: Server
delivery_phases.qa_verify_command: (cd linkshelf && go run./cmd/server & sleep 2); (cd linkshelf && curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/links | grep -q '[]'); (cd linkshelf && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/links -d '{"title":"test","url":"https://example.com"}') | grep -q 'test'; (cd linkshelf && curl -s -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/api/links/1); (ps aux | grep '[l]inkshelf' | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill)

delivery_phases.title: Frontend
delivery_phases.qa_verify_command: cd linkshelf/web && npm install --ignore-scripts && npx tsc --noEmit

delivery_phases.title: E2E and deployment
delivery_phases.qa_verify_command: (cd linkshelf && docker build -t linkshelf. && docker run -d --name linkshelf-app -p 8080:8080 linkshelf & sleep 2); (cd linkshelf && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx playwright test --config=web/playwright.config.js); (docker kill linkshelf-app && docker rm linkshelf-app)

validation.spec_summary: A minimal Go bookmarking app with SQLite persistence and a vanilla JS frontend. The backend serves the UI, static files, and a JSON API for link CRUD operations. The frontend loads and renders links from the API. E2E tests verify UI functionality using Playwright.
